$comment: Dependencies whose licence is outside the allowed list of test/licenses.test.js, each reviewed by hand. A name ending in * covers its platform packages. The test fails if the licence changes, if the package stops being a development or optional dependency, or if an entry no longer matches anything.

exceptions.why: Rasterises SVG to PNG for previews, README images and the MCP render tool. A development dependency at the root and an optional one in mcp/; it is never bundled into the kit or the pages, so MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft never applies to the kit's code.
